narrative.details: As you can see, Champion, we still need to pack away more food for the soldiers. I don't know if you've ever been in a war before, but once you get past the initial shock of the battlefield, you can get pretty hungry. You did a good job last time, so I expect that you'll do as well, if not a little quicker, in getting me another stack of those lean wolf steaks.
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Lean Wolf Steaks to Bloodguard Rawtar at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
